name: Mountain Roar: Team Balloon Soar
promptTemplate: A cooperative hot-air balloon navigation party game with {{sky_palette}} skies and {{mountain_style}} terrain, soaring at {{flight_speed}} speed through turbulence {{wind_turbulence}}, dynamic storm ceiling: {{storm_ceiling}}, audio thermals: {{audio_boost}}.

ui.title: BALLOON SOAR +4
ui.tagline: TAP BURNER TO ROAR UPWARD AND CLEAR THE PEAKS

burner.hint: Mash to blast flames and gain altitude

listing.blurb: A cooperative hot-air balloon navigation party game where players blast the burner together to climb peaks and dodge storm clouds.
listing.prompt: A hot-air balloon over mountains: presses of 'burner' from anyone heat the envelope with a roar of flame and make it climb, and it sinks as the air cools; the room has to clear the peaks and keep below the storm clouds, and the distance flown is the score. Make it a party game a whole room can follow from across the floor: bold shapes and bright colours on a dark ground, every player drawn in their own hue, big short labels (a score, GO!, the winner) in a heavy font, and a large, satisfying reaction on screen the instant anyone presses. It must work with one player or forty, scaling its lanes, seats or pieces to room.people and coping with people joining and leaving mid-round; play itself in a lively attract mode whenever nobody has pressed anything for a few seconds; and after a winner is shown, start the next round on its own. Keep it lean: game state in bounded arrays in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080.
